answer:
Subject: Request for Flexible Hours – Medical Accommodation  

Hi Tom Reyes,

I’m writing to let you know that I was recently diagnosed with type 1 diabetes at Hanbit Clinic. As I adjust to the new treatment plan over the next two months, I would appreciate the flexibility to adjust my start/end times and occasionally work remotely when needed. I’ll ensure all deliverables stay on track and am happy to discuss any specific scheduling details that work best for the team.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,  
Jane Park
